title: Umbrella: make ComfyUI engine bumps safe, repeatable and gated (MPI-457 + MPI-467)
description: Dispatch handle for the two engine-bump cards, which overlap and would otherwise both write the same playbook. MPI-465 shipped a completely dead LTX to every user on 1.3.0/1.3.1 for six days because a ComfyUI bump changed a return type under a custom node and nothing in this repo ever EXECUTES a workflow. MPI-457 owns the mechanic (in-place /engine/upgrade + the repo-side bump skill); MPI-467 owns the guard (docs/playbooks/bump-engine/ + a smoke runner that really generates + the release gate). Hand a separate session THIS id: brief.md carries the ownership split, the build order, and the machine constraints that make a naive parallel run collide with the LTX and H3 work in flight.
acceptance: One session owns both children end to end - no second agent writing into docs/playbooks/bump-engine/ at the same time
MPI-457 and MPI-467 both close, or the survivor states in writing what was dropped and why
The smoke gate is wired into mpi-release, not just written down
Nothing in this work edits dev_configs/node_lock.json - the LTX and H3 sessions own that file right now
activeSessionTitle: Engine-bump guard: playbook + Pod smoke runner + release gate
